Description.SourceString:
These red dragons are only lesser when compared to Fuzan, the strongest red dragon currently active in the region.  Despite their weaker stature to their draconic overlord, the lesser red dragons are still some of the deadliest creatures in the region.

Like Fuzan, the red dragons here are fuelled by a desire to destroy. The fire that rages in their bellies yearns to be unleashed upon anything that moves - or doesn’t move (as some poor cacti have discovered). They torment the locals, and delight in their suffering.

A few red dragons give themselves grandiose names, in an attempt to claim their own legacy. One dragon, known as The Radiant, torments the Manafem Moon Garou. For years now, The Radiant has destroyed caravans, eaten travellers and brought suffering to the camp, for no reason other than their capacity to do so.

Cruelty is a deeply embedded trait in the red dragons of Ashenfall, and they view mercy as a weakness to be exploited.
